```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r load-data}
# -- Load the estimation dataset saved by ThesisManualH4_prep.Rmd -----------
est_data <- read.csv('./est_data.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(sprintf('Loaded %d observations\n', nrow(est_data)))
```

```{r regressions, results='asis'}
# -- Main regression results ---------------------------------------------------
# Three panels: (A) Full sample, (B) HBO only, (C) WO only.
# Within each panel: OLS and IV (2SLS) for Full, STEM, and Non-STEM.
# All models use aggregate share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg.
# Controls: age, age², education_years, hours_worked, hours², partner.
# Fixed effect: field. SEs clustered at field level.

# Control variables (inlined in each formula — feols doesn't expand formula objects)
ctrl <- "age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner + geslacht"
fe <- "field + survey_year"

# --- Panel A: All onderwijssoort (pooled) ------------------------------------

a_ols_full  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field)
a_iv_full   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field)
a_ols_stem  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field,
                      subset = ~ stem)
a_iv_stem   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field,
                      subset = ~ stem)
a_ols_nstem <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field,
                      subset = ~ !stem)
a_iv_nstem  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field,
                      subset = ~ !stem)

# First-stage F-stats (Panel A)
fs_a_full <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = est_data, cluster = ~ field)
fs_a_stem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = est_data, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
fs_a_nstem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                     data = est_data, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

f_a_full  <- round(wald(fs_a_full,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_a_stem  <- round(wald(fs_a_stem,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_a_nstem <- round(wald(fs_a_nstem, 'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\\textbf{Panel A: All Education Levels}\

')

etable(a_ols_full, a_iv_full, a_ols_stem, a_iv_stem, a_ols_nstem, a_iv_nstem,
       se.below = TRUE,
       dict = c(share_int_agg = 'Intl. Share'),
       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),
       headers = c('Full', '', 'STEM', '', 'Non-STEM', ''),
       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' =
                          c(f_a_full, f_a_full, f_a_stem, f_a_stem, f_a_nstem, f_a_nstem)))

# --- Panel B: HBO only -------------------------------------------------------

hbo <- est_data %>% filter(onderwijssoort == 'Hoger beroepsonderwijs')

b_ols_full  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field)
b_iv_full   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field)
b_ols_stem  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
b_iv_stem   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
b_ols_nstem <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)
b_iv_nstem  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

fs_b_full <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = hbo, cluster = ~ field)
fs_b_stem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
fs_b_nstem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                     data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

f_b_full  <- round(wald(fs_b_full,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_b_stem  <- round(wald(fs_b_stem,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_b_nstem <- round(wald(fs_b_nstem, 'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\\textbf{Panel B: HBO (Higher Professional Education)}\

')

etable(b_ols_full, b_iv_full, b_ols_stem, b_iv_stem, b_ols_nstem, b_iv_nstem,
       se.below = TRUE,
       dict = c(share_int_agg = 'Intl. Share'),
       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),
       headers = c('Full', '', 'STEM', '', 'Non-STEM', ''),
       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' =
                          c(f_b_full, f_b_full, f_b_stem, f_b_stem, f_b_nstem, f_b_nstem)))

# --- Panel C: WO only --------------------------------------------------------

wo <- est_data %>% filter(onderwijssoort == 'Wetenschappelijk onderwijs')

c_ols_full  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = wo, cluster = ~ field)
c_iv_full   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = wo, cluster = ~ field)
c_ols_stem  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
c_iv_stem   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
c_ols_nstem <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)
c_iv_nstem  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

fs_c_full <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = wo, cluster = ~ field)
fs_c_stem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
fs_c_nstem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                     data = wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

f_c_full  <- round(wald(fs_c_full,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_c_stem  <- round(wald(fs_c_stem,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_c_nstem <- round(wald(fs_c_nstem, 'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\\textbf{Panel C: WO (Research University)}\

')

etable(c_ols_full, c_iv_full, c_ols_stem, c_iv_stem, c_ols_nstem, c_iv_nstem,
       se.below = TRUE,
       dict = c(share_int_agg = 'Intl. Share'),
       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),
       headers = c('Full', '', 'STEM', '', 'Non-STEM', ''),
       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' =
                          c(f_c_full, f_c_full, f_c_stem, f_c_stem, f_c_nstem, f_c_nstem)))

# --- Panel D: HBO + WO pooled (tertiary education only) ----------------------

hbo_wo <- est_data %>% filter(onderwijssoort %in% c("Hoger beroepsonderwijs", "Wetenschappelijk onderwijs"))

d_ols_full  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                      data = hbo_wo, cluster = ~ field)
d_iv_full   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field + onderwijssoort |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = hbo_wo, cluster = ~ field)
d_ols_stem  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                      data = hbo_wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
d_iv_stem   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field + onderwijssoort |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = hbo_wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
d_ols_nstem <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                      data = hbo_wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)
d_iv_nstem  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field + onderwijssoort |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = hbo_wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

fs_d_full <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                    data = hbo_wo, cluster = ~ field)
fs_d_stem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                    data = hbo_wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
fs_d_nstem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                     data = hbo_wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

f_d_full  <- round(wald(fs_d_full,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_d_stem  <- round(wald(fs_d_stem,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_d_nstem <- round(wald(fs_d_nstem, 'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\n\\textbf{Panel D: HBO + WO (Tertiary Education)}\\n\n')

etable(d_ols_full, d_iv_full, d_ols_stem, d_iv_stem, d_ols_nstem, d_iv_nstem,
       se.below = TRUE,
       dict = c(share_int_agg = 'Intl. Share'),
       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),

                          c(f_d_full, f_d_full, f_d_stem, f_d_stem, f_d_nstem, f_d_nstem)))

# --- Panel F: Gender Effects -------------------------------------------------

female <- est_data %>% filter(geslacht == 'female')
male   <- est_data %>% filter(geslacht == 'male')

# OLS with gender interaction
f_ols_interact <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg * geslacht + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                        data = est_data, cluster = ~ field)

# IV split by gender
f_iv_female <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                      share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                     data = female, cluster = ~ field)
f_iv_male <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                    share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                   data = male, cluster = ~ field)

# First-stage F-stats (split by gender)
fs_female <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                   data = female, cluster = ~ field)
fs_male <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                 data = male, cluster = ~ field)

f_female <- round(wald(fs_female, 'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_male   <- round(wald(fs_male,   'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\n\\textbf{Panel F: Gender Effects}\\
\\textit{OLS with interaction; IV estimated separately by gender.}\\
\\textit{Gender subsample F-stats: Females = ', f_female, ', Males = ', f_male, '.}\\

')

etable(f_ols_interact, f_iv_female, f_iv_male,
       se.below = TRUE,
       dict = c(share_int_agg = 'Intl. Share',
                'share_int_agg:geslachtmale' = 'Intl. Share × Male'),
       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),
       headers = c('OLS (interact)', 'IV: Female', 'IV: Male'),
       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' = c('', f_female, f_male)))
```


```{r regressions-lag}
# -- Panel E: Lagged IV specifications --------------------------------------
# OLS + IV pairs for contemporaneous and lagged instruments.
# 'Long-term' = all three lags jointly instrumenting share_int_agg.
# Full sample only (not split by STEM).

# Build lagged instruments
lags <- est_data %>%
  group_by(field, survey_year) %>%
  summarise(Z_visa = first(Z_visa_field_agg), .groups = 'drop')

est_data_lag <- est_data
for (L in 1:3) {
  lag_df <- lags
  lag_df$survey_year <- lag_df$survey_year + L
  names(lag_df)[3] <- paste0('Z_visa_lag', L)
  est_data_lag <- est_data_lag %>% left_join(lag_df, by = c('field', 'survey_year'))
}

# OLS + IV pairs for each specification
ols_contemp <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)
iv_contemp  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)

ols_lag1 <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                   data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)
iv_lag1  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                    share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_lag1,
                   data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)

ols_lag2 <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                   data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)
iv_lag2  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                    share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_lag2,
                   data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)

ols_lag3 <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                   data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)
iv_lag3  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                    share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_lag3,
                   data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)

ols_all <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                  data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)
iv_all  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                   share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_lag1 + Z_visa_lag2 + Z_visa_lag3,
                  data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)

# First-stage F-stats
fs_contemp <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                     data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)
fs_lag1 <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_lag1 + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                  data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)
fs_lag2 <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_lag2 + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                  data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)
fs_lag3 <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_lag3 + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                  data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)
fs_all <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_lag1 + Z_visa_lag2 + Z_visa_lag3 + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                 data = est_data_lag, cluster = ~ field)

f_contemp <- round(wald(fs_contemp, 'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_lag1 <- round(wald(fs_lag1, 'Z_visa_lag1', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_lag2 <- round(wald(fs_lag2, 'Z_visa_lag2', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_lag3 <- round(wald(fs_lag3, 'Z_visa_lag3', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_all <- round(wald(fs_all, c('Z_visa_lag1', 'Z_visa_lag2', 'Z_visa_lag3'), print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\n\\textbf{Panel E: Lagged IV Specifications}\\n\\textit{Each pair: OLS | IV. Long-term = lags 1-3 jointly.}\\n
')

etable(ols_contemp, iv_contemp, ols_lag1, iv_lag1, ols_lag2, iv_lag2, ols_lag3, iv_lag3, ols_all, iv_all,
       se.below = TRUE,
       dict = c(share_int_agg = 'Intl. Share'),
       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),
       headers = c('Contemp', '', 'Lag 1', '', 'Lag 2', '', 'Lag 3', '', 'Long-term', ''),
       subtitles = c('OLS', 'IV', 'OLS', 'IV', 'OLS', 'IV', 'OLS', 'IV', 'OLS', 'IV'),
       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' =
                          c('', f_contemp, '', f_lag1, '', f_lag2, '', f_lag3, '', f_all)))
```

```{r regressions-z, results='asis'}
# -- Standardized regressions ---------------------------------------------------
# Same 4 panels as above but with z-score standardized continuous variables
# so coefficients represent the effect of a one-SD change.

est_data_z <- est_data %>%
  mutate(across(c(share_int_agg, age, education_years, hours_worked,
                   log_income, Z_visa_field_agg),
                ~ ( . - mean(., na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
                .names = "{.col}_z")) %>%
  mutate(age_sq_z = age_z^2,
         hours_sq_z = hours_worked_z^2)

cat('\n\n\\textbf{Standardized Regressions}\\n\n')
cat('All continuous variables normalized to z-scores (mean 0, SD 1).\n\n')

# --- Panel A: All onderwijssoort (pooled) ------------------------------------

az_ols_full  <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                        education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                        partner | field,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field)
az_iv_full   <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                        hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                        share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field)
az_ols_stem  <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                        education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                        partner | field,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
az_iv_stem   <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                        hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                        share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
az_ols_nstem <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                        education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                        partner | field,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)
az_iv_nstem  <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                        hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                        share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

fs_az_full <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                      education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                      partner | field,
                    data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field)
fs_az_stem <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                      education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                      partner | field,
                    data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
fs_az_nstem <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                       education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                       partner | field,
                     data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

f_az_full  <- round(wald(fs_az_full,  'Z_visa_field_agg_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_az_stem  <- round(wald(fs_az_stem,  'Z_visa_field_agg_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_az_nstem <- round(wald(fs_az_nstem, 'Z_visa_field_agg_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\n\\textbf{Panel A: All Education Levels (Standardized)}\\n\n')

etable(az_ols_full, az_iv_full, az_ols_stem, az_iv_stem, az_ols_nstem, az_iv_nstem,
       se.below = TRUE,
       dict = c(share_int_agg_z = 'Intl. Share (z)', Z_visa_field_agg_z = 'Visa Instr. (z)'),
       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),
       headers = c('Full', '', 'STEM', '', 'Non-STEM', ''),
       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' =
                          c(f_az_full, f_az_full, f_az_stem, f_az_stem,
                            f_az_nstem, f_az_nstem)))

# --- Panel B: HBO only -------------------------------------------------------

hbo_z <- est_data_z %>% filter(onderwijssoort == 'Hoger beroepsonderwijs')
```

```{r regressions-z-lag}
# -- Panel E-z: Lagged IV specifications (standardized) ---------------------

lags_z <- est_data_z %>%
  group_by(field, survey_year) %>%
  summarise(Z_visa_z = first(Z_visa_field_agg_z), .groups = 'drop')

est_data_lag_z <- est_data_z
for (L in 1:3) {
  lag_df <- lags_z
  lag_df$survey_year <- lag_df$survey_year + L
  names(lag_df)[3] <- paste0('Z_visa_lag', L, '_z')
  est_data_lag_z <- est_data_lag_z %>% left_join(lag_df, by = c('field', 'survey_year'))
}

# OLS + IV pairs
ols_contemp_z <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                         education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                         partner | field,
                       data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)
iv_contemp_z  <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                         hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                         share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z,
                       data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)

ols_lag1_z <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                      education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                      partner | field,
                    data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)

                      hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                      share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_lag1_z,
                    data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)

ols_lag2_z <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                      education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                      partner | field,
                    data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)
iv_lag2_z  <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                      hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                      share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_lag2_z,
                    data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)

ols_lag3_z <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                      education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                      partner | field,
                    data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)
iv_lag3_z  <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                      hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                      share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_lag3_z,
                    data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)

ols_all_z <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                     education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                     partner | field,
                   data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)
iv_all_z  <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                     hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                     share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_lag1_z + Z_visa_lag2_z + Z_visa_lag3_z,
                   data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)

fs_contemp_z <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field,
                       data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)
fs_lag1_z <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_lag1_z + age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field,
                    data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)
fs_lag2_z <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_lag2_z + age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field,
                    data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)
fs_lag3_z <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_lag3_z + age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field,
                    data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)
fs_all_z <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_lag1_z + Z_visa_lag2_z + Z_visa_lag3_z + age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field,
                   data = est_data_lag_z, cluster = ~ field)

f_contemp_z <- round(wald(fs_contemp_z, 'Z_visa_field_agg_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_lag1_z <- round(wald(fs_lag1_z, 'Z_visa_lag1_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

')

etable(ols_contemp_z, iv_contemp_z, ols_lag1_z, iv_lag1_z, ols_lag2_z, iv_lag2_z, ols_lag3_z, iv_lag3_z, ols_all_z, iv_all_z,

       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' =
                          c('', f_contemp_z, '', f_lag1_z, '', f_lag2_z, '', f_lag3_z, '', f_all_z)))
```
